The '''1708 [[FLLA]] World Cup''' was the 10th edition of the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international [[Arraby]] tournament contested by the senior men's national teams of the member associations of the [[FLLA]]. It was held in [[United Delet]] across [[New Ayre]], and was won by [[United Delet]], who defeated [[Raledria]] 3-1 in the final.

The 1708 edition was the first FLLA World Cup staged outside [[Ayuma]] or [[Atirha]], hosted by [[United Delet]] in [[New Ayre]]. The hosts won the trophy on home soil, defeating the defending champions [[Raledria]] 3-1 in the final. The tournament is also remembered as the first FLLA World Cup to be widely covered by photojournalists from across the seven confederations, with selected fixtures relayed by short-range radio to neighbouring nations.
